entry.title: New: Resolution 342 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
CREATES ONE NEW GRANT COORDINATOR POSITION, ONE NEW PUBLIC SAFETY COUNSELOR POSITION, AND ONE NEW HUMAN RESOURCES SPECIALIST II POSITION FOR THE POLICE DEPARTMENT

Establishes three new positions to (1) identify and evaluate potential funding sources, (2) support employees and their families by maintaining a safe and productive work environment, and (3) address the department’s personnel expansion.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 342-23 & FC-111 - 12/06/23
